hero.title: Humanity & Ethics: The Teachings of Buddha
hero.description: An exploration of the core philosophical tenets of Gautama Buddha, focusing on the Four Noble Truths and the Eightfold Path.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Tenets

  • Four Noble Truths (Aryasatyani)
  • Eightfold Path (Astangika Marga)
  • Pratityasamutpada (Dependent Origination)

Philosophical Concepts

  • Anatta (No-Self)
  • Anicca (Impermanence)
  • Dukkha (Suffering)
  • Teachings of Buddha:
    • Four Noble Truths: Dukkha, Samudaya, Nirodha, Magga.
    • Eightfold Path (Astangika Marga): Right View, Resolve, Speech, Action, Livelihood, Effort, Mindfulness, Concentration.
    • Ahinsa: Emphasized as a social and spiritual code.

First Buddhist Council at Rajgriha; compilation of Sutta and Vinaya Pitakas.

items.title: V-R-S-A-L-E-M-C
items.phrase: Right View, Resolve, Speech, Action, Livelihood, Effort, Mindfulness, Concentration
items.decryption: Categories: Wisdom (V, R), Ethical Conduct (S, A, L), Mental Discipline (E, M, C).

items: Assuming Buddhism rejects God; it is essentially agnostic rather than explicitly atheistic.
Confusing 'Anatta' (No-Soul) with the Upanishadic concept of 'Atman'.
Assuming 'Nirvana' is equivalent to 'Moksha' in the Vedic sense; they differ significantly in their ontological status.
